Troubled Tribesmen#001.src: Oui tuh'd ihtancdyht y funt E ys cyoehk. Dryd kio Krattson ybbaync du cbayg ouin myhkiyka.
Troubled Tribesmen#001.dst: Oui tuh'd ihtancdyht y funt E ys cyoehk. Dryd kio Krattson ybbaync du cbayg ouin myhkiyka.
Troubled Tribesmen#001.speaker:
Ka L'argwit
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Troubled Tribesmen#002.src: But despite my efforts, he just sat in silence with his eyes closed. He must've known I wasn't a threat because he was totally exposed. He had no interest in speaking with me, though.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.dst: でもどんなに頑張っても、彼は目を閉じて黙って座ってるだけ。無防備だったから、僕が脅威じゃないと分かってたはず。でも僕と話す気は全然なかった。
Troubled Tribesmen#002.speaker:
Krattson
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Troubled Tribesmen#003.src: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb dras.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.dst: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb dras.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.speaker:
Shaman Inrekei
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Troubled Tribesmen#004.src: What did Ka L'argwit have to say? ...I see... please go and speak with him as soon as possible.

Troubled Tribesmen#005.src: For as long as I am able to recall upon, my people have called this tree our guardian. She shares her magic with those who respect her and keep her healthy.

Troubled Tribesmen#006.src: Or so, she did. A few sunrises ago, an outlandish creature cascaded through the tree's magic barrier as if it was made of cotton!

Troubled Tribesmen#007.src: It burrowed deep within the roots, and unleashed huge egg pods. They're filled with disgusting insects that are draining her of protective magic.

Troubled Tribesmen#008.src: And to make matters worse.. they must be replacing the magic with corruption. Just look at her, she's obviously very sick!

Troubled Tribesmen#009.src: Even some of our own people have lost their minds and have become very dangerous. It just crushes my soul to see this happening before my eyes.

Troubled Tribesmen#010.src: Our protective magic is extremely weak right now. If I try to stop the creature myself I will surely be vanquished. You on the other hand, look most protected.

Troubled Tribesmen#011.src: It benefits us both if the creature is stopped. You will have a safer time traversing the jungle and our people will be saved.

Troubled Tribesmen#012.src: Simply follow the path of destruction. It started at the roots, so you should make your way in from there. Be cautious, and may Entamis guide you.

Troubled Tribesmen#013.src: Enter the base of the trunk, and Entamis will guide you to the creature.

Troubled Tribesmen#014.src: Hello again. I am grateful you have returned safely. You don't need to say anything, though. I no longer can sense Entamis. I know she has died...
Troubled Tribesmen#014.dst: また会ったな。戻ってくれて感謝する。だが何も言わなくていい。もう Entamis を感じられぬ。彼女が死んだのは分かっている…
Troubled Tribesmen#014.speaker:
Shaman Inrekei
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Troubled Tribesmen#015.src: You still managed to prevent her corrupted magic to spread any further. And for that, my people are forever in your debt.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.dst: それでも、そなたは彼女の腐敗した魔力がこれ以上広がるのを防いでくれた。我が民はそなたに永遠の恩がある。
Troubled Tribesmen#015.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#016.src: Please take this. It is but a small gift. Your currency is meaningless to us. In times of peril, few step forward and risk their lives to save those they do not know.
Troubled Tribesmen#016.dst: どうか受け取ってくれ。ささやかな贈り物だ。そなたらの通貨は我らには無意味。危機の時、見知らぬ者のために命を懸けて進み出る者は少ない。
Troubled Tribesmen#016.speaker:
Shaman Inrekei
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Troubled Tribesmen#019.src: Hey! Aren't these people fascinating? They sure smell bad, though! What? That Tribesman said my name?! Amazing! I've been trying to communicate with them for weeks.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.dst: やあ！この人たち、面白いと思わない？まあ、すごく臭うけどね！え？あの部族の人が僕の名前を言った！？すごい！何週間も意思疎通しようとしてたんだ。
Troubled Tribesmen#019.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#020.src: He sure seems like a distressed little fellow. He keeps pointing to that huge tree right there. A {p} keeper once told me it's possible to speak with them.
Troubled Tribesmen#020.dst: 何か困ってる小さな人みたいだね。ずっとあそこの大木を指さしてる。{p} の番人が、彼らと話す方法があるって教えてくれたんだ。
Troubled Tribesmen#020.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#021.src: He told me that within the woods there is a Shaman who will grant certain people permission to speak their language. I did some traveling through the jungle and actually found him!
Troubled Tribesmen#021.dst: 森の中に、限られた者に彼らの言葉を話す許しを与えるシャーマンがいるんだって。ジャングルを旅して、本当に見つけたんだよ！
Troubled Tribesmen#021.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#023.src: Say, who knows, maybe the Shaman will talk to you. It would greatly assist my research if you could help me talk to them. So why don't you give it a shot?
Troubled Tribesmen#023.dst: ねえ、もしかしたらシャーマンは君となら話すかも。彼らと話せるよう手伝ってくれたら研究がすごく助かるんだ。試してみない？
Troubled Tribesmen#023.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#024.src: Follow this path to the north. Keep going past the pond and the path will split to the West and to the East. Take the West path, and you will see the Shaman.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.dst: この道を北へ。池を過ぎると道が東西に分かれるから、西の道を行けばシャーマンがいるよ。
Troubled Tribesmen#024.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#025.dst: シャーマン Inrekei と話す。

Troubled Tribesmen#027.src: I have cast a spell on you. If you can understand me, you are pure of heart.
Troubled Tribesmen#027.dst: そなたに術をかけた。私の言葉が分かるなら、そなたの心は清い。
Troubled Tribesmen#027.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#028.src: This spell will allow those of true spirit to speak and comprehend our language. I have entrusted you with this because of my connection with our sacred tree, who we call Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#028.dst: この術は、真の心を持つ者に我らの言葉を話し理解する力を与える。聖なる木 Entamis と私の繋がりゆえに、そなたにこれを託した。
Troubled Tribesmen#028.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#029.src: I am the shaman of my tribe. I sit here every day with my eyes closed and carefully monitor Entamis' wavelengths. She has not been responding to my calls as of late...
Troubled Tribesmen#029.dst: 私はこの部族のシャーマン。毎日ここで目を閉じて座り、Entamis の波動を注意深く見守っている。だが近頃、彼女は私の呼びかけに応えぬ…
Troubled Tribesmen#029.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#030.src: Dear human, your presence emits warmth and trust. Please go speak with my apprentice, Ka L'argwit. He is to take my place as shaman when I pass from this life.
Troubled Tribesmen#030.dst: 人間よ、そなたからは温もりと信頼を感じる。どうか弟子の Ka L'argwit と話してくれ。私がこの世を去れば、彼がシャーマンを継ぐ。
Troubled Tribesmen#030.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#031.src: He would know if anything is causing our beautiful tree discomfort. The spell I have cast on you will allow you to speak with him.
Troubled Tribesmen#031.dst: 我らの美しい木を苦しめるものがあれば、彼には分かるはずだ。私がかけた術で彼と話せる。
Troubled Tribesmen#031.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#032.src: Now, please go seek out Ka L'argwit.
Troubled Tribesmen#032.dst: さあ、Ka L'argwit を訪ねてくれ。
Troubled Tribesmen#032.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#035.src: Thank you for coming. We haven't but moments. The monster's name is Aenara. He's a fiendish monster of corruption.
Troubled Tribesmen#035.dst: 来てくれてありがとう。時間がありません。魔物の名は Aenara。腐敗の邪悪な魔物です。
Troubled Tribesmen#035.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#036.src: He unleashed egg pods that host a variety of magic draining insects. They are eating me alive and replacing my magic with evil magic. Soon I will die.
Troubled Tribesmen#036.dst: 彼は様々な魔力を吸う虫を宿した卵嚢を放ちました。虫たちは私を生きたまま食らい、魔力を邪悪なものに変えています。私はもうすぐ死ぬでしょう。
Troubled Tribesmen#036.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#037.src: You mustn't let me be reborn a creature of evil...
Troubled Tribesmen#037.dst: 私を邪悪な存在として生まれ変わらせないで…
Troubled Tribesmen#037.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#038.src: Kill Aenara and bring an Insect of Corruption to Shaman Inrekei.
Troubled Tribesmen#038.dst: Aenara を倒し、腐敗の虫をシャーマン Inrekei に届ける。

Troubled Tribesmen#041.src: This insect appears to be the queen. I'll need to perform a ritual to kill it permanently. But never mind that, I can do that in my own time.
Troubled Tribesmen#041.dst: この虫は女王のようだ。完全に殺すには儀式が要る。だがそれは気にするな、私が自分でやれる。
Troubled Tribesmen#041.speaker: Inrekei
